# 50 Five-Star Hotels

50 Five-Star Hotels is a traveller-facing guide to affordable five-star and near-five-star hotels around the world.

Core positioning: five-star hotels without five-star prices.

The site focuses on:
- affordable five-star hotels
- cheap five-star hotels worth considering
- luxury hotels on a budget
- best-value five-star hotels
- honest five-star classification checks
- ordinary but good hotel research for clean, reliable, fairly priced stays
- hotel timing by month, including weather, value, crowds and practical risks
- price tiers under EUR50, under EUR100, under EUR200 and under EUR250
